svg.title: Autocomplete latency by query class
svg.desc: p1: sift 0.19, sift (positions off) 0.19, Elasticsearch 0.33, pg_search 0.55, pg_textsearch 551, rum 22.83, pgx-bm25 5.04; p2: sift 0.37, sift (positions off) 0.37, Elasticsearch 0.85, pg_search 0.93, pg_textsearch 117, rum 10.75, pgx-bm25 2.44; p3: sift 0.18, sift (positions off) 0.17, Elasticsearch 0.29, pg_search 0.64, pg_textsearch 10.12, rum 2.75, pgx-bm25 27.88; p4: sift 0.28, sift (positions off) 0.30, Elasticsearch 0.63, pg_search 1.01, pg_textsearch 6.39, rum 1.02, pgx-bm25 5.56; w1: sift 0.15, sift (positions off) 0.14, Elasticsearch 0.20, pg_search 0.77, pg_textsearch 2.82, rum 0.24, pgx-bm25 1.61; a2: sift 0.17, sift (positions off) 0.16, Elasticsearch 0.21, pg_search 0.87, pg_textsearch 2.85, rum 4.57, pgx-bm25 2.84; a2s: sift 0.26, sift (positions off) 0.33, Elasticsearch 0.66, pg_search 1.25, pg_textsearch 3.76, rum 16.97, pgx-bm25 7.31; a3: sift 0.18, sift (positions off) 0.18, Elasticsearch 0.27, pg_search 1.31, pg_textsearch 2.91, rum 4.80, pgx-bm25 5.92; x2: sift 0.20, sift (positions off) 0.19, Elasticsearch 0.28, pg_search 1.05, pg_textsearch 2.98, rum 4.04, pgx-bm25 3.85
svg.text: p50 milliseconds, logarithmic axis, lower is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
p2, p4, a2s: measured in a later run (load avg 10-15).
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP, edge n-grams of the typed words expanded by the client.
pg_textsearch: emulation (edge n-gram text, it has no native prefix scoring), see docs/BENCHMARKS.md.
p1-p4: 1-4 letter prefix; w1: whole word; a2, a2s: word + 2 or 1 letter prefix; a3, x2: 3 or 2 prefixes
GeoNames cities15000, 34,165 places, top-20, 1 client, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 6-7); Oct 2026.
